properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.quality_gate.block_on_errors
properties.description: Block update set commits when the quality scanner reports any 'error' severity findings.

properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.quality_gate.min_score
properties.description: Minimum quality score (0-100) required to commit. 0 disables this gate.

properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.docs.auto_regenerate
properties.description: Automatically regenerate documentation when a tracked record changes.

properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.governance.log_all_changes
properties.description: Append every captured update_xml row to the NowForge governance log.

properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.governance.high_risk_tables
properties.description: Comma-separated list of tables whose changes are tagged 'high' risk in the governance log.

properties.name: x_nowfg_nowforge.scan.max_records_per_table
properties.description: Limit on records scanned per script table to keep scan time bounded.
